const EV = J('data-evidence'), ST = J('data-stepper'), IND = J('data-indicators'), CON = J('data-concepts'), EN = J('data-entry'), CF = J('data-confound');
const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const MINUS = '−';
const C = {accent:'#1f5fa8', base:'#9aa0a8', baseSoft:'#ecedef', warn:'#b8541a', ink:'#1b1d21', ink2:'#4a4f57', line:'#e3e3de', grid:'#eeeeea'};

function S(tag, attrs, parent){ const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); if(attrs) for(const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if(parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
function E(tag, attrs, html){ const e = document.createElement(tag); if(attrs) for(const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if(html != null) e.innerHTML = html; return e; }
function esc(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c])); }
function f(x, d = 3, sign = true){ if(x == null || Number.isNaN(x)) return 'n/a'; const s = Math.abs(x).toFixed(d); if(Number(s) === 0) return (0).toFixed(d); return (x < 0 ? MINUS : (sign ? '+' : '')) + s; }
function u(x, d = 3){ return f(x, d, false); }
function ci(lo, hi, d = 3){ return '[' + f(lo, d) + ', ' + f(hi, d) + ']'; }
function i2(x){ return x === 0 ? '0' : x.toFixed(2); }
function pct(x, d = 1){ return (100 * x).toFixed(d) + '%'; }

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const tip = $('chart-tip');
function placeFixed(box, rect){
  box.style.left = '0px'; box.style.top = '0px';
  const w = box.offsetWidth, h = box.offsetHeight, vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  let L = Math.min(Math.max(8, rect.left + rect.width / 2 - w / 2), vw - w - 8);
  let T = rect.top - h - 8; if(T < 8) T = rect.bottom + 8;
  box.style.left = L + 'px'; box.style.top = T + 'px';
}
function showTip(html, el, rect){ tip.innerHTML = html; tip.classList.add('on'); placeFixed(tip, rect || el.getBoundingClientRect()); }
function hideTip(){ tip.classList.remove('on'); }
function bindMark(g, htmlFn, label, onPick){
  g.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); g.setAttribute('role', onPick ? 'button' : 'img'); g.setAttribute('aria-label', label); g.classList.add('mark');
  const anchor = () => (g.querySelector('.anchor') || g).getBoundingClientRect();
  const show = () => showTip(htmlFn(), g, anchor());
  g.addEventListener('mouseenter', show); g.addEventListener('focus', show);
  g.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); if(onPick) onPick(); else show(); });
  g.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(onPick && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')){ e.preventDefault(); onPick(); } });
  g.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTip); g.addEventListener('blur', hideTip);
}
document.addEventListener('click', hideTip);
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key === 'Escape') hideTip(); });
window.addEventListener('scroll', hideTip, {passive:true});

/* ---------- text measurement and ticks ---------- */
let meas = null;
function tw(text, cls){
  if(!meas){ meas = S('svg', {width:'10', height:'10', 'aria-hidden':'true', style:'position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;visibility:hidden'}); document.body.appendChild(meas); }
  const t = S('text', {class:cls}, meas); t.textContent = text; const w = t.getComputedTextLength(); meas.removeChild(t); return w;
}
function ticks(a, b, n){
  const span = b - a, step0 = span / Math.max(1, n), mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(step0))), err = step0 / mag;
  const step = (err >= 7.5 ? 10 : err >= 3.5 ? 5 : err >= 1.5 ? 2 : 1) * mag; const vals = [];
  for(let v = Math.ceil(a / step - 1e-9) * step; v <= b + 1e-9; v += step) vals.push(Number(v.toFixed(10)));
  return {vals, step, d: Math.max(0, -Math.floor(Math.log10(step) + 1e-9))};
}
function niceDomain(vals, incl0){
  let lo = Math.min(...vals), hi = Math.max(...vals); if(incl0){ lo = Math.min(lo, 0); hi = Math.max(hi, 0); }
  const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.06 || 0.05; return [lo - pad, hi + pad];
}
function mkSvg(host, W, H, label){
  host.innerHTML = ''; const svg = S('svg', {viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`, width:W, height:H, role:'group', 'aria-label':label || host.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'chart'}, host); return svg;
}
function xAxis(svg, x, dom, ml, plotW, top, bottom, title, nTicks){
  const t = ticks(dom[0], dom[1], nTicks), ax = S('g', {class:'ax'}, svg);
  t.vals.forEach(v => { S('line', {x1:x(v), x2:x(v), y1:top, y2:bottom, class:'gridl'}, ax); const tx = S('text', {x:x(v), y:bottom + 16, 'text-anchor':'middle'}, ax); tx.textContent = f(v, t.d, false); });
  S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml + plotW, y1:bottom, y2:bottom}, ax);
  const at = S('text', {x:ml + plotW / 2, y:bottom + 36, 'text-anchor':'middle', class:'axtitle'}, svg); at.textContent = title;
}

/* ---------- interval (forest) chart ---------- */
function intervalChart(host, cfg){
  const W = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth), narrow = W < 600;
  const rows = cfg.rows, real = rows.filter(r => r.kind !== 'sep');
  const lab = r => (narrow && r.short) ? r.short : r.label;
  const labW = Math.max(...real.map(r => tw(lab(r), 'rowlab' + (r.bold ? ' b' : ''))));
  let valW = Math.max(0, ...real.map(r => r.valText ? tw(r.valText, 'vallab') : 0));
  let ml = labW + 14, mr = valW + 16, rowH = narrow ? 30 : 32;
  let plotW = W - ml - mr;
  if(plotW < 130){ mr = 12; valW = 0; plotW = W - ml - mr; }
  const vals = []; real.forEach(r => { [r.est, r.lo, r.hi, r.base, r.hollow].forEach(v => { if(v != null) vals.push(v); }); if(r.band) vals.push(-r.band, r.band); });
  (cfg.refs || []).forEach(rf => vals.push(rf.x));
  const dom = cfg.domain || niceDomain(vals, cfg.incl0 !== false);
  let y = 8; rows.forEach(r => { r._y = y + (r.kind === 'sep' ? 8 : rowH / 2); y += r.kind === 'sep' ? 16 : rowH; });
  const bottom = y + 2, Hh = bottom + 46;
  const svg = mkSvg(host, W, Hh, cfg.label);
  const x = v => ml + (v - dom[0]) / (dom[1] - dom[0]) * plotW;
  xAxis(svg, x, dom, ml, plotW, 4, bottom, narrow && cfg.xTitleShort ? cfg.xTitleShort : cfg.xTitle, Math.max(2, Math.floor(plotW / 70)));
  (cfg.refs || []).forEach(rf => S('line', {x1:x(rf.x), x2:x(rf.x), y1:4, y2:bottom, stroke:rf.color || '#6b7079', 'stroke-dasharray':rf.dash || '4 3', 'stroke-width':1.2}, svg));
  rows.forEach(r => {
    if(r.kind === 'sep'){ S('line', {x1:0, x2:W, y1:r._y, y2:r._y, stroke:C.line}, svg); return; }
    const g = S('g', null, svg), cy = r._y;
    S('rect', {x:0, y:cy - rowH / 2, width:W, height:rowH, fill:'transparent', class:'hit'}, g);
    if(r.band) S('rect', {x:x(-r.band), y:cy - rowH / 2 + 5, width:x(r.band) - x(-r.band), height:rowH - 10, fill:C.baseSoft}, g);
    const tl = S('text', {x:ml - 10, y:cy + 4.5, 'text-anchor':'end', class:'rowlab', 'font-weight':r.bold ? 700 : 400, fill:r.labColor || C.ink}, g); tl.textContent = lab(r);
    const col = r.color || C.accent;
    if(r.kind === 'diamond'){
      S('polygon', {points:`${x(r.lo)},${cy} ${x(r.est)},${cy - 8} ${x(r.hi)},${cy} ${x(r.est)},${cy + 8}`, fill:col, class:'anchor'}, g);
    } else if(r.kind === 'pair'){
      S('line', {x1:x(r.base), x2:x(r.est), y1:cy, y2:cy, stroke:'#c9c9c3', 'stroke-width':3}, g);
      S('circle', {cx:x(r.base), cy, r:6, fill:C.base}, g);
      S('circle', {cx:x(r.est), cy, r:6, fill:col, class:'anchor'}, g);
    } else {
      if(r.lo != null) S('line', {x1:x(r.lo), x2:x(r.hi), y1:cy, y2:cy, stroke:col, 'stroke-width':2.2}, g);
      if(r.lo != null){ S('line', {x1:x(r.lo), x2:x(r.lo), y1:cy - 5, y2:cy + 5, stroke:col, 'stroke-width':2}, g); S('line', {x1:x(r.hi), x2:x(r.hi), y1:cy - 5, y2:cy + 5, stroke:col, 'stroke-width':2}, g); }
      if(r.hollow != null) S('circle', {cx:x(r.hollow), cy, r:5.5, fill:'#fff', stroke:C.ink2, 'stroke-width':2}, g);
      S(r.square ? 'rect' : 'circle', r.square ? {x:x(r.est) - 5.5, y:cy - 5.5, width:11, height:11, fill:col, class:'anchor'} : {cx:x(r.est), cy, r:5.5, fill:col, class:'anchor'}, g);
    }
    if(r.valText && valW){ const vt = S('text', {x:W - valW - 4, y:cy + 4.5, class:'vallab'}, g); vt.textContent = r.valText; }
    bindMark(g, () => r.tip, r.aria || (r.label + ': ' + (r.valText || '')), r.onPick);
  });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- horizontal bar chart (one or more series) ---------- */
function barChart(host, cfg){
  const W = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth), narrow = W < 600;
  const rows = cfg.rows, ns = cfg.series.length;
  const labW = Math.max(...rows.map(r => tw(r.label, 'rowlab')));
  let valW = Math.max(0, ...rows.map(r => r.valText ? tw(r.valText, 'vallab') : 0));
  let ml = labW + 14, mr = valW ? valW + 16 : 14, plotW = W - ml - mr;
  if(plotW < 120){ valW = 0; mr = 14; plotW = W - ml - mr; }
  const bh = ns > 1 ? (narrow ? 8 : 9) : 14, gap = 3, rowH = ns * bh + (ns - 1) * gap + 12;
  const all = []; rows.forEach(r => r.vals.forEach(v => { if(v != null) all.push(v); }));
  const dom = cfg.domain || [Math.min(0, ...all), Math.max(0, ...all) * 1.04 || 1];
  const bottom = 8 + rows.length * rowH, Hh = bottom + 46;
  const svg = mkSvg(host, W, Hh, cfg.label);
  const x = v => ml + (v - dom[0]) / (dom[1] - dom[0]) * plotW;
  xAxis(svg, x, dom, ml, plotW, 4, bottom, narrow && cfg.xTitleShort ? cfg.xTitleShort : cfg.xTitle, Math.max(2, Math.floor(plotW / 70)));
  S('line', {x1:x(0), x2:x(0), y1:4, y2:bottom, stroke:'#6b7079'}, svg);
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const top = 8 + i * rowH, g = S('g', null, svg);
    S('rect', {x:0, y:top, width:W, height:rowH, fill:r.hl ? '#fbeee6' : 'transparent', class:'hit'}, g);
    const tl = S('text', {x:ml - 10, y:top + rowH / 2 + 4.5, 'text-anchor':'end', class:'rowlab', 'font-weight':r.bold ? 700 : 400, fill:r.bold ? C.warn : C.ink}, g); tl.textContent = r.label;
    r.vals.forEach((v, k) => { if(v == null) return; const y0 = top + 6 + k * (bh + gap), x0 = x(Math.min(0, v)), x1 = x(Math.max(0, v));
      S('rect', {x:x0, y:y0, width:Math.max(1, x1 - x0), height:bh, fill:(r.colors && r.colors[k]) || cfg.series[k].color, class:k === ns - 1 ? 'anchor' : ''}, g); });
    if(r.valText && valW){ const vt = S('text', {x:W - valW - 4, y:top + rowH / 2 + 4.5, class:'vallab'}, g); vt.textContent = r.valText; }
    bindMark(g, () => r.tip, r.aria || r.label);
  });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- line chart ---------- */
function lineChart(host, cfg){
  const W = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth), Hh = Math.min(320, Math.max(230, W * 0.42));
  const yt = ticks(cfg.ydom[0], cfg.ydom[1], 5), yl = yt.vals.map(v => f(v, yt.d, false) + (cfg.ySuffix || ''));
  const tickW = Math.max(...yl.map(s => tw(s, 'ax')));
  const ml = tickW + 8 + 16 + 12, mr = 16, mt = 12, mb = 50, plotW = W - ml - mr, plotH = Hh - mt - mb;
  const svg = mkSvg(host, W, Hh, cfg.label);
  const x = v => ml + (v - cfg.xdom[0]) / (cfg.xdom[1] - cfg.xdom[0]) * plotW, y = v => mt + plotH - (v - cfg.ydom[0]) / (cfg.ydom[1] - cfg.ydom[0]) * plotH;
  const ax = S('g', {class:'ax'}, svg);
  yt.vals.forEach((v, i) => { S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml + plotW, y1:y(v), y2:y(v), class:'gridl'}, ax); const t = S('text', {x:ml - 8, y:y(v) + 4, 'text-anchor':'end'}, ax); t.textContent = yl[i]; });
  const xt = ticks(cfg.xdom[0], cfg.xdom[1], Math.max(2, Math.floor(plotW / 70)));
  xt.vals.forEach(v => { const t = S('text', {x:x(v), y:mt + plotH + 16, 'text-anchor':'middle'}, ax); t.textContent = f(v, xt.d, false) + (cfg.xSuffix || ''); });
  S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml + plotW, y1:mt + plotH, y2:mt + plotH}, ax); S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml, y1:mt, y2:mt + plotH}, ax);
  const xtl = S('text', {x:ml + plotW / 2, y:Hh - 8, 'text-anchor':'middle', class:'axtitle'}, svg); xtl.textContent = cfg.xTitle;
  const ytl = S('text', {x:0, y:0, transform:`translate(14 ${mt + plotH / 2}) rotate(-90)`, 'text-anchor':'middle', class:'axtitle'}, svg); ytl.textContent = cfg.yTitle;
  (cfg.hlines || []).forEach(h => S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml + plotW, y1:y(h.y), y2:y(h.y), stroke:C.base, 'stroke-width':2, 'stroke-dasharray':'6 4'}, svg));
  cfg.series.forEach(s => S('polyline', {points:s.pts.map(p => x(p[0]) + ',' + y(p[1])).join(' '), fill:'none', stroke:s.color, 'stroke-width':2.4}, svg));
  (cfg.vlines || []).forEach(v => S('line', {x1:x(v), x2:x(v), y1:mt, y2:mt + plotH, stroke:'#6b7079', 'stroke-dasharray':'2 3'}, svg));
  (cfg.points || []).forEach(p => { const g = S('g', null, svg); S('circle', {cx:x(p.x), cy:y(p.y), r:7, fill:C.warn, stroke:'#fff', 'stroke-width':2, class:'anchor'}, g); bindMark(g, () => p.tip, p.aria); });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- scatter with roving keyboard focus ---------- */
function scatter(host, cfg){
  const W = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth), Hh = Math.min(360, Math.max(250, W * 0.62));
  const xs = cfg.pts.map(p => p.x), ys = cfg.pts.map(p => p.y);
  const xd = niceDomain(xs.length ? xs : [0, 1], false), yd = niceDomain(ys.length ? ys.concat([0]) : [-1, 1], true);
  const yt = ticks(yd[0], yd[1], 5), yl = yt.vals.map(v => f(v, yt.d, false));
  const ml = Math.max(...yl.map(s => tw(s, 'ax'))) + 8 + 16 + 12, mr = 14, mt = 10, mb = 50, plotW = W - ml - mr, plotH = Hh - mt - mb;
  const svg = mkSvg(host, W, Hh, cfg.label);
  const x = v => ml + (v - xd[0]) / (xd[1] - xd[0]) * plotW, y = v => mt + plotH - (v - yd[0]) / (yd[1] - yd[0]) * plotH;
  const ax = S('g', {class:'ax'}, svg);
  yt.vals.forEach((v, i) => { S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml + plotW, y1:y(v), y2:y(v), class:'gridl'}, ax); const t = S('text', {x:ml - 8, y:y(v) + 4, 'text-anchor':'end'}, ax); t.textContent = yl[i]; });
  const xt = ticks(xd[0], xd[1], Math.max(2, Math.floor(plotW / 70)));
  xt.vals.forEach(v => { S('line', {x1:x(v), x2:x(v), y1:mt, y2:mt + plotH, class:'gridl'}, ax); const t = S('text', {x:x(v), y:mt + plotH + 16, 'text-anchor':'middle'}, ax); t.textContent = f(v, xt.d, false); });
  S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml + plotW, y1:mt + plotH, y2:mt + plotH}, ax);
  S('line', {x1:ml, x2:ml + plotW, y1:y(0), y2:y(0), stroke:C.base, 'stroke-width':1.6, 'stroke-dasharray':'6 4'}, svg);
  const xtl = S('text', {x:ml + plotW / 2, y:Hh - 8, 'text-anchor':'middle', class:'axtitle'}, svg); xtl.textContent = cfg.xTitle;
  const ytl = S('text', {x:0, y:0, transform:`translate(14 ${mt + plotH / 2}) rotate(-90)`, 'text-anchor':'middle', class:'axtitle'}, svg); ytl.textContent = W < 480 && cfg.yTitleShort ? cfg.yTitleShort : cfg.yTitle;
  const g = S('g', {tabindex:'0', role:'listbox', 'aria-label':cfg.label + '. Use left and right arrow keys to move between points, Enter to select.'}, svg);
  g.classList.add('mark');
  const order = cfg.pts.map((p, i) => i).sort((a, b) => cfg.pts[a].x - cfg.pts[b].x);
  const dots = cfg.pts.map((p, i) => { const c = S('circle', {cx:x(p.x), cy:y(p.y), r:p.sel ? 7 : 4, fill:p.sel ? C.warn : C.accent, 'fill-opacity':p.sel ? 1 : 0.45, stroke:p.sel ? '#fff' : 'none', 'stroke-width':2}, g);
    c.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => showTip(cfg.tip(p), c)); c.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTip);
    c.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); showTip(cfg.tip(p), c); cfg.onPick(p); }); return c; });
  const selIdx = cfg.pts.findIndex(p => p.sel); if(selIdx >= 0) g.appendChild(dots[selIdx]);
  let cur = Math.max(0, order.indexOf(selIdx));
  const focusPt = () => { if(!order.length) return; const i = order[cur]; showTip(cfg.tip(cfg.pts[i]), dots[i]); };
  g.addEventListener('focus', focusPt); g.addEventListener('blur', hideTip);
  g.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowUp'){ cur = Math.min(order.length - 1, cur + 1); focusPt(); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowDown'){ cur = Math.max(0, cur - 1); focusPt(); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if(e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' '){ e.preventDefault(); cfg.onPick(cfg.pts[order[cur]]); } });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- radio segments ---------- */
function radios(host, name, opts, value, onChange){
  host.innerHTML = '';
  opts.forEach(([v, l]) => { const lab = E('label'); const inp = E('input', {type:'radio', name, value:v}); inp.checked = v === value; lab.appendChild(inp); lab.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', l); if(inp.checked) lab.classList.add('on');
    inp.addEventListener('change', () => { host.querySelectorAll('label').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x.querySelector('input').checked)); onChange(v); }); host.appendChild(lab); });
}

/* ---------- glossary + term tooltips ---------- */
const GLOSS = {
  ego:['Co-occurrence ego network','The concept’s positive-PMI neighbour topics in the topic co-occurrence backbone over its first three years (t0 to t0+2); edges are links between those topics in the backbone.'],
  b5:['B5 baseline','The five-feature popularity baseline: log early volume, publication growth, non-home share, Shannon entropy and field reach, all computed over t0 to t0+2.'],
  open:['OPEN index','The mean of six signed z-scored ego-network components from t0 to t0+2: new edge rate, number of Leiden communities, participation coefficient and NOV_res (positive sign), ego density and edge persistence (negative sign). The z-score constants are frozen from the DEV data.'],
  openhome:['OPEN_home','The OPEN index built on the home-field co-occurrence graph only. OPEN_all uses the corpus-wide graph; OPEN_sizematch subsamples corpus-wide papers to home counts.'],
  psp:['Partial Spearman priority (PSP)','The Pearson correlation of rank-transformed indicator and outcome residuals, both residualised on the baseline covariates and control rungs. Inference uses 2,000 concept-level bootstrap resamples with refit.'],
  o2r:['Rarefied field breadth (O2r)','The expected number of distinct venue fields among a fixed-size random draw of m = 50 papers from a concept’s publications in years t0+6 to t0+8, by exact hypergeometric rarefaction. It separates size-adjusted breadth from sheer volume.'],
  rung:['Control rung','Steps of the control ladder. R0 controls for B5 plus onset year. R2 adds contact reach, concept type, a generic-concept flag and concept level. R3 adds the pre-onset footprint.'],
  dl:['DerSimonian–Laird pool','The random-effects estimator used to pool estimates across field groups or bodies, reported with I² heterogeneity.'],
  i2:['I²','The share of variation between bodies that reflects heterogeneity rather than sampling error.'],
  sel:['Selection body','The data on which an index or indicator was chosen (DEV for OPEN_home). It is shown for reference but not pooled; non-selection bodies are the four held-out groups and the two onset cohorts.'],
  clogit:['Conditional logit','A Breslow partial-likelihood model on concept-year risk sets, stratified by concept-year, with standardised covariates. Each stratum is one concept in one year, and the model scores which candidate field it enters.'],
  d0:['Retained-frontier relatedness (d0)','The log-odds of entering a field per SD of relatedness to the off-home fields that currently retain the concept, from the conditional-logit entry model.'],
  retain:['Retaining field','A field retains a concept when it has published at least two grounded papers on the concept in each of the two most recent years.'],
  pmi:['PMI backbone','Relatedness between fields measured by positive pointwise mutual information on the field-level backbone, frozen on 1998–2002 data.'],
  t0:['Onset year (t0)','The first year a concept reaches 20 grounded publications.'],
  home:['Home field','The field(s) holding at least 40% of the concept’s first 30 grounded papers.'],
  leiden:['Leiden community','A topic community found by the Leiden algorithm; n_comm counts how many distinct communities a concept’s neighbours span.'],
  novres:['NOV_res','Neighbourhood novelty residual: the novelty of a concept’s co-occurrence partners after residualising on degree.'],
  persist:['Edge persistence','The fraction of the concept’s neighbours retained across windows.'],
  novchurn:['NOVCHURN','The mean of z(NOV_res) and −z(edge persistence), a two-component novelty/churn measure used in the mechanism analyses.'],
  volmatch:['Volume-matched contrast','Compares entry rates of retained versus entered-but-not-retained fields in the same volume cell. The pre-registered rule required its CI to lie above zero.'],
  mincp:['Minimum-conditional-probability proximity','The standard product-space proximity of Hidalgo et al. (2007), used in place of PMI as a check on the backbone.']
};
let openTT = null;
function closeTT(){ if(openTT){ openTT.tt.hidden = true; openTT = null; } }
function initTerms(root){
  let n = document.querySelectorAll('.tt').length;
  root.querySelectorAll('button.term:not([data-bound])').forEach(b => {
    b.setAttribute('data-bound', '1'); b.type = 'button';
    const g = GLOSS[b.dataset.term]; if(!g) return;
    const tt = E('div', {class:'tt', role:'tooltip', id:'tt-' + (n++)}, '<strong>' + esc(g[0]) + '</strong>' + esc(g[1])); tt.hidden = true; document.body.appendChild(tt);
    b.setAttribute('aria-describedby', tt.id);
    const open = () => { if(openTT && openTT.tt !== tt) closeTT(); tt.hidden = false; placeFixed(tt, b.getBoundingClientRect()); openTT = {tt, b}; };
    b.addEventListener('mouseenter', open); b.addEventListener('focus', open); b.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); open(); });
    b.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { if(openTT && openTT.tt === tt && document.activeElement !== b) closeTT(); });
    b.addEventListener('blur', () => { if(openTT && openTT.tt === tt) closeTT(); });
  });
}
document.addEventListener('click', e => { if(openTT && !openTT.b.contains(e.target)) closeTT(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key === 'Escape') closeTT(); });
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if(openTT) placeFixed(openTT.tt, openTT.b.getBoundingClientRect()); }, {passive:true});
function T(key, text){ return `<button class="term" data-term="${key}">${text}</button>`; }

/* =========================== 1. EVIDENCE =========================== */
const BODY = {B2_PHYS:['Physical Sciences','PHYS','held-out group, onsets 2003–09'], B2_LIFEENV:['Life & Environment','LIFEENV','held-out group, onsets 2003–09'], B2_SOC:['Social Sciences','SOC','held-out group, onsets 2003–09'], B2_MATHDEC:['Math & Decision','MATHDEC','held-out group, onsets 2003–09'], B3_EXP5_COHORT_2010_14:['2010–14 cohort','Coh. 10–14','onset cohort 2010–14'], B4_COHORT_2015_17:['2015–17 cohort','Coh. 15–17','fresh onset cohort 2015–17'], B1_DEV:['DEV (selection)','DEV','development set, onsets 2003–09']};
const FEAT = {OPEN_home:'OPEN<sub>home</sub>', NOVCHURN_home:'NOVCHURN<sub>home</sub>'};
const FEATT = {OPEN_home:'OPEN_home', NOVCHURN_home:'NOVCHURN_home'};
const ev = {feature:'OPEN_home', rung:'R2', sel:true};
function bigNumber(){ const p = EV.pools['OPEN_home|R2']; $('big-num').innerHTML = f(p.est) + `<small>95% CI ${ci(p.lo, p.hi)} · I² = ${i2(p.I2)} · ${p.sign} bodies positive · control rung R2</small>`; }
function drawEv(){
  const pool = EV.pools[ev.feature + '|' + ev.rung];
  const rows = EV.rows.filter(r => r.feature === ev.feature && r[ev.rung]);
  const byBody = Object.fromEntries(rows.map(r => [r.body, r]));
  const out = [];
  const mk = (r, isSel) => { const c = r[ev.rung], b = BODY[r.body];
    return {label:b[0], short:b[1], est:c.psp, lo:c.lo, hi:c.hi, color:isSel ? C.base : C.accent, labColor:isSel ? C.ink2 : C.ink, square:true,
      band:(ev.rung === 'R2' && !isSel) ? r.placebo_p95 : null, valText:f(c.psp) + ' ' + ci(c.lo, c.hi),
      tip:`<b>${esc(b[0])}</b> (${b[2]})<br>${FEATT[ev.feature]}, rung ${ev.rung}<br>PSP ${f(c.psp)} ${ci(c.lo, c.hi)}<br>n = ${c.n.toLocaleString()} concepts analysed of ${r.n_body.toLocaleString()}` + (r.placebo_p95 != null ? `<br>Placebo 95th pct |PSP| (R2): ${u(r.placebo_p95)}` : '') + `<br>Status: ${esc(r.status)}`}; };
  pool.bodies.forEach(bk => { if(byBody[bk]) out.push(mk(byBody[bk], false)); });
  out.push({kind:'diamond', label:`DL pool (k = ${pool.k})`, short:'Pool', est:pool.est, lo:pool.lo, hi:pool.hi, color:C.ink, bold:true, valText:f(pool.est) + ' ' + ci(pool.lo, pool.hi),
    tip:`<b>DerSimonian–Laird pool</b> over ${pool.k} non-selection bodies<br>${f(pool.est)} ${ci(pool.lo, pool.hi)}, I² = ${i2(pool.I2)}<br>${pool.sign} positive`});
  const selRows = rows.filter(r => !pool.bodies.includes(r.body));
  if(ev.sel && selRows.length){ out.push({kind:'sep'}); selRows.forEach(r => { const m = mk(r, true); if(r.body === 'B4_COHORT_2015_17'){ m.label = '2015–17 cohort (selection)'; m.short = 'Coh. 15–17 (sel.)'; } out.push(m); }); }
  intervalChart($('ev-chart'), {rows:out, xTitle:`Partial Spearman of ${FEATT[ev.feature]} with O2r (m = 50)`, xTitleShort:'Partial Spearman with O2r', refs:[{x:0, dash:'5 4'}, {x:pool.est, dash:'1.5 3', color:C.ink}], label:'Forest plot of partial Spearman by body'});
  const non = pool.bodies.map(b => byBody[b]).filter(Boolean).map(r => r[ev.rung]);
  const npos = non.filter(c => c.psp > 0).length, nci = non.filter(c => c.lo > 0).length;
  const selTxt = ev.feature === 'OPEN_home' ? `The DEV selection body (${f(pool.sel)}) is ${pool.shrink.toFixed(2)}× the pool, the shrinkage expected after choosing an index on the same data.` : `The selection bodies (DEV and the 2015–17 cohort, where the index was chosen) are left out of the pool.`;
  $('ev-take').innerHTML = `${FEAT[ev.feature]} at rung ${ev.rung}: positive in ${npos} of ${non.length} non-selection bodies, but only ${nci} of them have a 95% CI above zero on their own. Pooled, ${f(pool.est)} ${ci(pool.lo, pool.hi)}, I² = ${i2(pool.I2)}. ${selTxt}`;
}
radios($('ev-feature'), 'evf', [['OPEN_home', 'OPEN<sub>home</sub>'], ['NOVCHURN_home', 'NOVCHURN<sub>home</sub>']], ev.feature, v => { ev.feature = v; drawEv(); });
radios($('ev-rung'), 'evr', [['R0', 'R0'], ['R2', 'R2'], ['R3', 'R3']], ev.rung, v => { ev.rung = v; drawEv(); });
$('ev-sel').addEventListener('change', e => { ev.sel = e.target.checked; drawEv(); });

/* =========================== 2. STEPPER =========================== */
const G = ST.members.HIGH_OPEN, V = ST.members.LOW_OPEN;
const COMP = {new_edge_rate:'New edge rate', n_comm_W3:'Leiden communities (W3)', participation:'Participation', NOV_res:'NOV_res', ego_density_W3:'Ego density (W3)', edge_persistence:'Edge persistence'};
let stepBuild = 'all';
function openCalc(m, b){
  const zc = ST.zconst[b]; const parts = ST.components.map(([k, s]) => { const raw = m.components[b][k]; if(raw == null) return {k, s, raw:null, z:null};
    const z = (raw - zc[k].mean) / zc[k].sd; return {k, s, raw, z, sz:s * z}; });
  const ok = parts.filter(p => p.z != null); return {parts, open:ok.reduce((a, p) => a + p.sz, 0) / ok.length};
}
const STAGES = [
  {name:'Ground', title:'1. Ground the concept and date its onset',
   inp:`OpenAlex works whose titles match the label “${G.name}”, kept after the per-concept LLM precision gate.`,
   op:`Find the ${T('t0', 'onset year')} (first year with 20 grounded papers) and the ${T('home', 'home field')} (the field with at least 40% of the first 30 papers).`,
   out:() => `<dl class="kv"><dt>Onset year t<sub>0</sub></dt><dd>${G.t0}</dd><dt>Home field</dt><dd>${esc(G.home_name)}</dd><dt>Reporting group</dt><dd>${esc(G.group)}</dd></dl>`,
   why:'Every later measure is taken relative to the onset year and the home field, so concepts born in different years and fields line up on the same clock.'},
  {name:'Baseline', title:'2. Compute the B5 popularity baseline',
   inp:`GPU’s grounded papers in ${G.t0}–${G.t0 + 2} (t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2).`,
   op:`Five popularity features: ${T('b5', 'B5')}. Every network signal is judged by what it adds beyond these.`,
   out:() => `<dl class="kv"><dt>log early volume</dt><dd>${u(G.B5.logvol)}</dd><dt>growth</dt><dd>${u(G.B5.growth_c)}</dd><dt>non-home share</dt><dd>${u(G.B5.offhome_share)}</dd><dt>Shannon entropy</dt><dd>${u(G.B5.entropy)}</dd><dt>field reach</dt><dd>${G.B5.reach}</dd></dl>`,
   why:'Popularity already explains much of later breadth (B5 Spearman 0.65–0.86), so the question is never whether a signal correlates with breadth but whether it adds to B5.'},
  {name:'Ego network', title:'3. Build the early co-occurrence ego network',
   inp:'Topics that co-occur with GPU on its papers, year by year over the first three years.',
   op:`Keep positive-PMI neighbour topics, link them through the topic backbone and group them into ${T('leiden', 'Leiden communities')}.`,
   out:() => { const s = G.ego; return `<dl class="kv"><dt>W3, all papers</dt><dd>${s.HIGH_OPEN_W3_all.n_nodes} topics, ${s.HIGH_OPEN_W3_all.n_communities} communities</dd><dt>W3 density</dt><dd>${u(s.HIGH_OPEN_W3_all.density, 2)}</dd><dt>W3, home papers</dt><dd>${s.HIGH_OPEN_W3_home.n_nodes} topics, ${s.HIGH_OPEN_W3_home.n_communities} communities</dd></dl>`; },
   extra:() => { const s = G.ego, keys = [['HIGH_OPEN_W1_all', 'Year t₀ (W1)'], ['HIGH_OPEN_W2_all', 't₀..t₀+1 (W2)'], ['HIGH_OPEN_W3_all', 't₀..t₀+2 (W3)'], ['HIGH_OPEN_W3_home', 'W3, home papers only']];
     const host = E('div', {class:'chart', role:'figure', 'aria-label':'Ego network size by window'}); $('step-extra').appendChild(host);
     barChart(host, {series:[{name:'Topics', color:C.accent}, {name:'Communities', color:C.base}], xTitle:'Count (topics in blue, Leiden communities in grey)', xTitleShort:'Topics (blue), communities (grey)',
       rows:keys.map(([k, l]) => ({label:l, vals:[s[k].n_nodes, s[k].n_communities], valText:`${s[k].n_nodes} / ${s[k].n_communities}`, tip:`<b>${l}</b><br>${s[k].n_nodes} topics, ${s[k].n_edges} edges<br>${s[k].n_communities} communities, density ${u(s[k].density, 2)}`, aria:`${l}: ${s[k].n_nodes} topics, ${s[k].n_communities} communities`}))});
     const ul = E('p', {class:'note'}, 'Strongest W3 neighbour topics: ' + G.neighbours.map(n => esc(n[0])).join('; ') + '.'); $('step-extra').appendChild(ul); },
   why:'The neighbourhood widens fast: the number of topics nearly triples from the first year to the three-year window. The home-only graph is much smaller and denser, which is why OPEN_home is the conservative build.'},
  {name:'OPEN', title:'4. Score openness: six components become one index',
   inp:'Six ego-network measures from the three-year window, in the build chosen below.',
   op:`z-score each with the constants frozen on the 12,499-concept frame, flip the sign of ego density and ${T('persist', 'edge persistence')}, and average. The page does this arithmetic live.`,
   out:() => { const c = openCalc(G, stepBuild); return `<dl class="kv"><dt>OPEN computed here</dt><dd><b>${f(c.open, 4)}</b></dd><dt>OPEN recorded</dt><dd>${f(G.OPEN[stepBuild], 4)}</dd><dt>Build</dt><dd>${stepBuild}</dd></dl>`; },
   extra:() => { const box = E('div', {class:'controls'}); box.innerHTML = '<fieldset><legend>Build</legend><div class="seg" id="st-build"></div></fieldset>'; $('step-extra').appendChild(box);
     radios($('st-build'), 'stb', [['all', 'All papers'], ['home', 'Home only'], ['size', 'Size-matched']], stepBuild, v => { stepBuild = v; renderStage(); });
     const c = openCalc(G, stepBuild), host = E('div', {class:'chart', role:'figure', 'aria-label':'Signed z-scores of the six OPEN components'}); $('step-extra').appendChild(host);
     barChart(host, {series:[{name:'signed z', color:C.accent}], xTitle:'Signed z-score (positive = more open)', xTitleShort:'Signed z-score',
       rows:c.parts.map(p => ({label:COMP[p.k] + (p.s < 0 ? ' (−)' : ''), vals:[p.sz], colors:[p.sz < 0 ? C.warn : C.accent], valText:p.sz == null ? 'n/a' : f(p.sz, 2), tip:`<b>${COMP[p.k]}</b><br>raw ${p.raw == null ? 'n/a' : u(p.raw)}<br>frozen mean ${u(ST.zconst[stepBuild][p.k].mean)}, sd ${u(ST.zconst[stepBuild][p.k].sd)}<br>sign ${p.s > 0 ? '+' : MINUS}, signed z ${p.sz == null ? 'n/a' : f(p.sz, 3)}`, aria:`${COMP[p.k]}: signed z ${p.sz == null ? 'n/a' : f(p.sz, 2)}`}))}); },
   why:`OPEN is high when the neighbourhood reaches many communities through new ties rather than closing into a dense, stable cluster. The paper’s headline uses ${T('openhome', 'OPEN_home')}, which avoids papers that also count toward the outcome.`},
  {name:'Breadth', title:'5. Measure breadth six to eight years later',
   inp:`GPU’s papers in ${G.t0 + 6}–${G.t0 + 8} and its field states from t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+8.`,
   op:`${T('o2r', 'Rarefied breadth')}: expected distinct venue fields in a draw of 50 papers. Separately, retained breadth is split exactly into early contact × frontier advance × retention.`,
   out:() => { const d = G.decomposition; return `<dl class="kv"><dt>O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50)</dt><dd><b>${u(G.outcomes.O2r_m50)}</b> fields</dd><dt>Fields entered by t<sub>0</sub>+2 (E2)</dt><dd>${d.E2}</dd><dt>Frontier advance (M)</dt><dd>${u(d.M)}</dd><dt>Retention (ρ)</dt><dd>${u(d.rho)}</dd><dt>E2 × M × ρ</dt><dd>${u(d.E2 * d.M * d.rho, 2)} = retained fields ${d.Bn}</dd></dl>`; },
   why:'Across DEV concepts, early contact diversity accounts for most of the gap between broad and narrow concepts; broad concepts do not enter new fields faster later on. GPU already touched 7 off-home fields by t0+2.'},
  {name:'Compare', title:'6. Set it beside a matched concept',
   inp:`${V.name} (onset ${V.t0}, same ${esc(V.home_name)} home), matched to GPU on early volume and growth.`,
   op:'Show both concepts’ openness and later breadth side by side. The pair was selected on OPEN, without looking at breadth.',
   out:() => `<dl class="kv"><dt>OPEN_all</dt><dd>${f(G.OPEN.all, 2)} vs ${f(V.OPEN.all, 2)}</dd><dt>OPEN_home</dt><dd>${f(G.OPEN.home, 2)} vs ${f(V.OPEN.home, 2)}</dd><dt>O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50)</dt><dd>${u(G.outcomes.O2r_m50, 2)} vs ${u(V.outcomes.O2r_m50, 2)}</dd></dl>`,
   extra:() => { const rowsT = [['log early volume', G.B5.logvol, V.B5.logvol, 3], ['growth', G.B5.growth_c, V.B5.growth_c, 3], ['OPEN_all', G.OPEN.all, V.OPEN.all, 3], ['OPEN_home', G.OPEN.home, V.OPEN.home, 3], ['Communities in W3 (all)', G.components.all.n_comm_W3, V.components.all.n_comm_W3, 0], ['Ego density W3 (all)', G.components.all.ego_density_W3, V.components.all.ego_density_W3, 2], ['Off-home fields entered by t₀+2', G.decomposition.E2, V.decomposition.E2, 0], ['Off-home fields retained at t₀+8', G.decomposition.Bn, V.decomposition.Bn, 0], ['O2r (m = 50)', G.outcomes.O2r_m50, V.outcomes.O2r_m50, 3], ['O2r residual on size', G.outcomes.O2r_resid, V.outcomes.O2r_resid, 3]];
     const t = E('div', {class:'scrollx'}, `<table><caption class="sr">GPU versus VAWT</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Recorded value</th><th scope="col" class="num">GPU</th><th scope="col" class="num">VAWT</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rowsT.map(r => `<tr><th scope="row">${r[0]}</th><td class="num">${u(r[1], r[3])}</td><td class="num">${u(r[2], r[3])}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`);
     $('step-extra').appendChild(t);
     const fig = E('figure', null, `<img src="figures/fig_case_study_v0.png" alt="Two-panel case study. Left: off-home fields entered and retained each year for GPU (black) and vertical-axis wind turbine (grey), GPU reaching 11 entered and 8 retained by year 8, VAWT 6 and 4. Right: GPU's ego network of 34 topics in 8 colour-coded communities, density 0.30, beside VAWT's 12 topics in one Engineering community, density 0.70." loading="lazy" width="1300" height="555"><figcaption>Illustrative matched case-study pair from Experiment 12 (case pair 1 of 7): graphics processing unit (GPU; onset t<sub>0</sub> = 2008, high early-neighbourhood openness OPEN) versus vertical-axis wind turbine (VAWT; t<sub>0</sub> = 2009, low OPEN). Both have an Engineering home field and are matched on early volume and growth. (a) Number of off-home venue fields each concept has ever entered (solid line, filled markers) and currently retains (dashed line, open markers) in each year from t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+8; GPU is shown in black and VAWT in grey on a shared axis. By t<sub>0</sub>+2 GPU had entered 7 off-home fields and VAWT 2; by t<sub>0</sub>+8 they had entered 11 and 6 and retained 8 and 4. (b, c) Topic co-occurrence ego networks over the first three years (t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2, all papers). The nodes are the concept’s positive-PMI neighbour topics (the concept itself is not drawn), the edges are links between those topics in the 2010–14 topic backbone, node area scales with the number of the concept’s papers carrying the topic, and colour gives the topic’s Leiden community, named by the plurality OpenAlex field of its topics (plus the runner-up field when it has at least 0.6 times as many). GPU’s neighbourhood has 34 topics in 8 communities (density 0.30), led by Engineering &amp; Physics, Computer Science and Medicine communities. VAWT’s has 12 topics in a single Engineering community (density 0.70). The pair illustrates the openness–breadth association and is not evidence for it (case_pairs.json, pair 1).</figcaption>`);
     $('step-extra').appendChild(fig); },
   why:'In all 7 matched pairs the high-OPEN member has the higher size-adjusted breadth. With n ≤ 8 pairs chosen for contrast, that is an illustration; the evidence is the pooled estimate above.'}
];
let step = 0;
function drawPipe(){
  const host = $('step-pipe'), W = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth), cols = W < 640 ? 3 : 6, rowsN = Math.ceil(STAGES.length / cols);
  const gapX = 14, bw = (W - gapX * (cols - 1)) / cols, bh = 40, Hh = rowsN * bh + (rowsN - 1) * 16 + 4;
  host.innerHTML = ''; const svg = S('svg', {viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${Hh}`, width:W, height:Hh, role:'img', 'aria-label':'Pipeline: ' + STAGES.map((s, i) => (i + 1) + ' ' + s.name).join(', ') + '. Current stage ' + (step + 1)}, host);
  STAGES.forEach((s, i) => { const c = i % cols, r = Math.floor(i / cols), x0 = c * (bw + gapX), y0 = 2 + r * (bh + 16);
    if(i < STAGES.length - 1 && c < cols - 1) S('path', {d:`M${x0 + bw + 2} ${y0 + bh / 2} l${gapX - 6} 0 m-5 -4 l5 4 l-5 4`, stroke:'#9aa0a8', fill:'none', 'stroke-width':1.6}, svg);
    const g = S('g', {class:'node' + (i === step ? ' cur' : i < step ? ' done' : '')}, svg);
    S('rect', {x:x0, y:y0, width:bw, height:bh, rx:7}, g); const t = S('text', {x:x0 + bw / 2, y:y0 + bh / 2 + 4.5, 'text-anchor':'middle'}, g); t.textContent = (i + 1) + '. ' + s.name;
    g.addEventListener('click', () => go(i)); });
}
function renderStage(){
  const s = STAGES[step];
  $('step-title').textContent = s.title;
  $('step-body').innerHTML = `<div class="card"><h4>What goes in</h4><p>${s.inp}</p></div><div class="card"><h4>What is done</h4><p>${s.op}</p></div><div class="card"><h4>What comes out (recorded)</h4>${s.out()}</div>`;
  $('step-extra').innerHTML = ''; if(s.extra) s.extra();
  $('step-why').innerHTML = '<b>Why:</b> ' + s.why;
  initTerms($('stepper'));
}
function go(i){
  step = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i));
  $('step-markers').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b, k) => { if(k === step) b.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step'); else b.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
  $('step-prev').disabled = step === 0; $('step-next').disabled = step === STAGES.length - 1;
  $('step-live').textContent = `Stage ${step + 1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${STAGES[step].title.replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '')}`;
  drawPipe(); renderStage();
}
STAGES.forEach((s, i) => { const li = E('li'); const b = E('button', {type:'button'}, (i + 1) + '. ' + s.name); b.addEventListener('click', () => go(i)); li.appendChild(b); $('step-markers').appendChild(li); });
$('step-prev').addEventListener('click', () => go(step - 1)); $('step-next').addEventListener('click', () => go(step + 1));
$('stepper').addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'SELECT') return; if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ go(step - 1); e.preventDefault(); } else if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ go(step + 1); e.preventDefault(); } });

/* =========================== 3. INDICATORS =========================== */
const UNIT = {PHYS:'Physical Sciences', LIFEENV:'Life & Environment', SOC:'Social Sciences', MATHDEC:'Math & Decision', COH_DEVHOME:'2010–14 cohort, DEV homes', COH_OTHER:'2010–14 cohort, other homes'};
const UNITS = {PHYS:'PHYS', LIFEENV:'LIFEENV', SOC:'SOC', MATHDEC:'MATHDEC', COH_DEVHOME:'Coh. DEV homes', COH_OTHER:'Coh. other'};
const FAM = {FR:'retained frontier', A:'ego-network', G:'gateway', F:'disciplinary', E:'popularity', S:'co-author'};
let indSel = IND[0].id, indConf = false;
function fillIndSelect(){ const s = $('ind-sel'); s.innerHTML = ''; IND.filter(q => !indConf || q.confirmed).forEach(q => s.appendChild(E('option', {value:q.id}, esc(q.label) + ' (' + q.family + ')'))); if(![...s.options].some(o => o.value === indSel)) indSel = s.options[0].value; s.value = indSel; }
function drawInd(){
  const list = IND.filter(q => !indConf || q.confirmed);
  intervalChart($('ind-over'), {label:'Pooled held-out PSP for the frozen indicators', xTitle:'Pooled partial Spearman with O2r (m = 50), held-out', xTitleShort:'Pooled PSP, held-out', refs:[{x:0}],
    rows:list.map(q => ({label:q.label + ' (' + q.family + ')', short:q.label, est:q.pooled, lo:q.lo, hi:q.hi, color:q.confirmed ? C.accent : C.base, bold:q.id === indSel, valText:f(q.pooled) + ' ' + ci(q.lo, q.hi),
      tip:`<b>${esc(q.label)}</b>, family ${q.family} (${FAM[q.family]})<br>Pooled ${f(q.pooled)} ${ci(q.lo, q.hi)}<br>I² = ${q.I2.toFixed(2)}, sign ${q.sign}<br>${q.confirmed ? 'Confirmed' : 'Not confirmed'}<br>Click to break down by unit`,
      onPick:() => { indSel = q.id; $('ind-sel').value = q.id; drawInd(); }}))});
  const q = IND.find(z => z.id === indSel);
  $('ind-h').innerHTML = esc(q.label) + ': estimate in each held-out unit';
  const rows = q.units.map(x => ({label:UNIT[x.u], short:UNITS[x.u], est:x.psp, lo:x.lo, hi:x.hi, color:(x.lo > 0 || x.hi < 0) ? C.accent : C.base, valText:f(x.psp) + ' ' + ci(x.lo, x.hi),
    tip:`<b>${UNIT[x.u]}</b><br>${esc(q.label)}: ${f(x.psp)} ${ci(x.lo, x.hi)}<br>n = ${x.n.toLocaleString()} concepts`}));
  rows.push({kind:'diamond', label:'DL pool', est:q.pooled, lo:q.lo, hi:q.hi, color:C.ink, bold:true, valText:f(q.pooled) + ' ' + ci(q.lo, q.hi), tip:`<b>DL pool</b><br>${f(q.pooled)} ${ci(q.lo, q.hi)}, I² = ${q.I2.toFixed(2)}`});
  intervalChart($('ind-chart'), {label:'Per-unit PSP for ' + q.label, xTitle:'Partial Spearman with O2r (m = 50)', xTitleShort:'PSP with O2r', refs:[{x:0}], rows});
  const nex = q.units.filter(x => x.lo > 0 || x.hi < 0).length;
  const dir = q.pooled > 0 ? 'broader' : 'narrower';
  $('ind-take').innerHTML = `${esc(q.label)} (${FAM[q.family]} family): pooled ${f(q.pooled)} ${ci(q.lo, q.hi)}, I² = ${q.I2.toFixed(2)}, same sign in ${q.sign} units, CI clear of zero in ${nex} of ${q.units.length}. ` +
    (q.confirmed ? `Confirmed: higher values go with ${dir} later spread, beyond B5.` : `Not confirmed: it fails Holm correction or its pooled CI reaches zero.`) + ` Across the screen, ${IND.filter(z => z.confirmed).length} of ${IND.length} frozen indicators are confirmed.`;
}
$('ind-sel').addEventListener('change', e => { indSel = e.target.value; drawInd(); });
$('ind-conf').addEventListener('change', e => { indConf = e.target.checked; fillIndSelect(); drawInd(); });

/* =========================== 4. CONCEPT BROWSER =========================== */
const CC = CON.cols, CR = CON.rows.map((r, i) => { const o = {i}; CC.forEach((c, k) => o[c] = r[k]); o.complete = o.OPEN_home != null && o.O2r_m50 != null && o.pred_B5 != null && o.pred_B5_OPEN != null; if(o.complete) o.resid = o.O2r_m50 - o.pred_B5; return o; });
const compl = CR.filter(o => o.complete), openSorted = compl.map(o => o.OPEN_home).sort((a, b) => a - b);
const Q75 = openSorted[Math.floor(0.75 * (openSorted.length - 1))];
CR.forEach(o => { o.fail = o.complete && o.OPEN_home >= Q75 && o.O2r_m50 < o.pred_B5; });
const cb = {group:'all', q:'', sort:'open', complete:true, fail:false, sel:null};
function rankArr(a){ const idx = a.map((v, i) => i).sort((x, y) => a[x] - a[y]), r = new Array(a.length); let i = 0; while(i < idx.length){ let j = i; while(j + 1 < idx.length && a[idx[j + 1]] === a[idx[i]]) j++; for(let k = i; k <= j; k++) r[idx[k]] = (i + j) / 2 + 1; i = j + 1; } return r; }
function pearson(a, b){ const n = a.length; if(n < 3) return null; const ma = a.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / n, mb = b.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / n; let sab = 0, sa = 0, sb = 0; for(let i = 0; i < n; i++){ sab += (a[i] - ma) * (b[i] - mb); sa += (a[i] - ma) ** 2; sb += (b[i] - mb) ** 2; } return sab / Math.sqrt(sa * sb); }
function spearman(a, b){ return pearson(rankArr(a), rankArr(b)); }
function cbFiltered(){
  let L = CR.filter(o => (cb.group === 'all' || o.group === cb.group) && (!cb.complete || o.complete) && (!cb.fail || o.fail) && (!cb.q || o.name.toLowerCase().includes(cb.q)));
  const key = {open:o => -(o.OPEN_home ?? -99), resid:o => -(o.resid ?? -99), resid_asc:o => (o.resid ?? 99), o2r:o => -(o.O2r_m50 ?? -99)}[cb.sort];
  L.sort(key ? (a, b) => key(a) - key(b) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  return L;
}
function cbDetail(o){
  if(!o){ $('cb-detail').innerHTML = '<p class="note">No concept matches this filter.</p>'; return; }
  const has = o.complete;
  const dB = has ? Math.abs(o.O2r_m50 - o.pred_B5) : null, dM = has ? Math.abs(o.O2r_m50 - o.pred_B5_OPEN) : null;
  const moved = has ? (dM < dB ? `closer to the observed value by ${u(dB - dM, 3)} fields` : dM > dB ? `further from the observed value by ${u(dM - dB, 3)} fields` : 'no closer') : '';
  $('cb-detail').innerHTML = `<h4 style="font-size:1.1rem;margin-top:0">${esc(o.name)}</h4>
    <p style="margin:0 0 6px"><span class="pill">${esc(o.group)}</span><span class="pill">home: ${esc(o.home_field || 'n/a')}</span><span class="pill">t₀ ${o.t0}</span><span class="pill">${esc(o.type || '')}</span>${o.fail ? '<span class="pill bad">open but narrow</span>' : ''}</p>
    <div class="side3"><div class="card base"><div class="lab">B5 forecast</div><div class="v">${o.pred_B5 == null ? 'n/a' : u(o.pred_B5, 2)}</div><div class="note">baseline, fields</div></div>
    <div class="card meth"><div class="lab">B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub></div><div class="v">${o.pred_B5_OPEN == null ? 'n/a' : u(o.pred_B5_OPEN, 2)}</div><div class="note">method, fields</div></div>
    <div class="card"><div class="lab">Observed O<sub>2r</sub></div><div class="v">${o.O2r_m50 == null ? 'n/a' : u(o.O2r_m50, 2)}</div><div class="note">t₀+6 to t₀+8</div></div></div>
    <p class="note" style="margin:4px 0 8px">${has ? `Adding OPEN<sub>home</sub> moved the forecast ${moved}.` : 'This concept lacks OPEN<sub>home</sub> or an outcome window, so it is outside the analysed 573.'}</p>
    <details><summary>Early inputs, t₀ to t₀+2</summary><dl class="kv" style="margin-top:6px"><dt>OPEN<sub>home</sub></dt><dd>${o.OPEN_home == null ? 'n/a' : f(o.OPEN_home)}</dd><dt>OPEN<sub>all</sub></dt><dd>${o.OPEN_all == null ? 'n/a' : f(o.OPEN_all)}</dd><dt>log early volume</dt><dd>${u(o.logvol)}</dd><dt>growth</dt><dd>${f(o.growth_c)}</dd><dt>non-home share</dt><dd>${u(o.offhome_share)}</dd><dt>entropy</dt><dd>${u(o.entropy)}</dd><dt>field reach</dt><dd>${o.reach}</dd><dt>home papers, early</dt><dd>${o.n_home_early}</dd></dl></details>`;
}
function selectConcept(i){ cb.sel = i; drawCB(true); }
function drawCB(keepScroll){
  const L = cbFiltered(), list = $('cb-list'), st = list.scrollTop;
  if(cb.sel == null || !L.some(o => o.i === cb.sel)) cb.sel = L.length ? L[0].i : null;
  list.innerHTML = '';
  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  L.forEach(o => { const li = E('li'); const b = E('button', {type:'button', 'aria-pressed':String(o.i === cb.sel)}, `<span>${esc(o.name)}</span><span class="meta">${o.OPEN_home == null ? 'OPEN n/a' : 'OPEN ' + f(o.OPEN_home, 2)} · ${o.O2r_m50 == null ? 'no outcome' : 'obs ' + u(o.O2r_m50, 1)}</span>`);
    b.addEventListener('click', () => selectConcept(o.i)); li.appendChild(b); frag.appendChild(li); });
  list.appendChild(frag); if(keepScroll) list.scrollTop = st;
  const pool = cb.complete ? compl.length : CR.length;
  $('cb-count').textContent = `Showing ${L.length.toLocaleString()} of ${CR.length.toLocaleString()} cohort concepts (${compl.length} have OPEN_home, both forecasts and an outcome window).`;
  cbDetail(CR[cb.sel] || null);
  const P = L.filter(o => o.complete);
  scatter($('cb-scatter'), {label:'OPEN_home against the B5 forecast error', xTitle:'OPEN_home (mean signed z)', yTitle:'Observed O2r minus B5 forecast (fields)', yTitleShort:'Observed − B5 forecast',
    pts:P.map(o => ({x:o.OPEN_home, y:o.resid, sel:o.i === cb.sel, o})), tip:p => `<b>${esc(p.o.name)}</b><br>OPEN_home ${f(p.o.OPEN_home)}<br>observed ${u(p.o.O2r_m50, 2)}, B5 forecast ${u(p.o.pred_B5, 2)}<br>error ${f(p.o.resid, 2)} fields`, onPick:p => selectConcept(p.o.i)});
  if(P.length >= 3){
    const closer = P.filter(o => Math.abs(o.O2r_m50 - o.pred_B5_OPEN) < Math.abs(o.O2r_m50 - o.pred_B5)).length;
    const rho = spearman(P.map(o => o.OPEN_home), P.map(o => o.resid));
    $('cb-take').innerHTML = `Among the ${P.length} analysed concepts shown, adding OPEN<sub>home</sub> brings the forecast closer to the observed breadth for ${closer} (${pct(closer / P.length)}). The rank correlation of OPEN<sub>home</sub> with the B5 error here is ${f(rho, 3)}. The page computes this over the points shown; it is not the paper’s PSP, which also controls for onset year, contact reach, concept type and more.`;
  } else $('cb-take').textContent = 'Too few analysed concepts in this filter to summarise; widen the filter.';
}
(function(){ const s = $('cb-group'); [['all', 'All groups']].concat([...new Set(CR.map(o => o.group))].sort().map(g => [g, g])).forEach(([v, l]) => s.appendChild(E('option', {value:v}, esc(l)))); })();
$('cb-group').addEventListener('change', e => { cb.group = e.target.value; drawCB(); });
$('cb-search').addEventListener('input', e => { cb.q = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase(); drawCB(); });
$('cb-sort').addEventListener('change', e => { cb.sort = e.target.value; drawCB(); });
$('cb-complete').addEventListener('change', e => { cb.complete = e.target.checked; drawCB(); });
$('cb-fail').addEventListener('change', e => { cb.fail = e.target.checked; drawCB(); });

/* =========================== 5. ENTRY =========================== */
let enMetric = 'd0';
function drawEnForest(){
  let rows;
  if(enMetric === 'd0'){
    rows = EN.units.map(x => ({label:x.name, short:x.u === 'COHORT' ? 'Cohort 10–14' : x.u, est:x.d0, lo:x.lo, hi:x.hi, color:x.u === 'MATHDEC' ? C.base : C.accent, valText:f(x.d0) + ' ' + ci(x.lo, x.hi),
      tip:`<b>${x.name}</b><br>d₀ ${f(x.d0)} ${ci(x.lo, x.hi)}` + (x.n ? `<br>${x.n.toLocaleString()} concepts, ${x.events.toLocaleString()} entry events` : '') + (x.u === 'MATHDEC' ? '<br>Excluded as underpowered before the freeze' : '')}));
    rows.push({kind:'sep'});
    const p = EN.pooled4; rows.push({label:'Held-out pooled model', short:'Pooled model', est:p.d0, lo:p.lo, hi:p.hi, color:C.accent, bold:true, square:true, valText:f(p.d0) + ' ' + ci(p.lo, p.hi), tip:`<b>One model on the 4 pooled held-out groups</b><br>d₀ ${f(p.d0)} ${ci(p.lo, p.hi)}<br>LR (R3 vs R2) ${p.LR}<br>${p.events.toLocaleString()} entry events in ${p.strata.toLocaleString()} strata`});
    const d = EN.DL; rows.push({kind:'diamond', label:'DL pool, 4 groups', short:'DL pool', est:d.d0, lo:d.lo, hi:d.hi, color:C.ink, bold:true, valText:f(d.d0) + ' ' + ci(d.lo, d.hi), tip:`<b>DerSimonian–Laird</b> over PHYS, LIFEENV, SOC, MATHDEC<br>${f(d.d0)} ${ci(d.lo, d.hi)}, I² = ${d.I2.toFixed(2)}`});
    intervalChart($('en-forest'), {label:'Retained-frontier coefficient by unit', xTitle:'d0: log-odds of entry per SD of retained-frontier relatedness', xTitleShort:'d0, log-odds per SD', refs:[{x:0}], rows});
    $('en-legend').innerHTML = '<li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>Evaluable unit, 95% concept-bootstrap CI</li><li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span>Underpowered (excluded before the freeze)</li><li><span class="sw" style="background:#1b1d21;transform:rotate(45deg) scale(.8)"></span>DL pool</li>';
    const pos = EN.units.filter(x => x.u !== 'MATHDEC' && x.lo > 0).length;
    $('en-take').innerHTML = `d<sub>0</sub> is positive with a CI above zero in ${pos} of ${EN.units.length - 1} evaluable units, including the 2010–14 cohort. The pooled held-out model gives ${f(EN.pooled4.d0)} ${ci(EN.pooled4.lo, EN.pooled4.hi)} (LR ${EN.pooled4.LR}); the group-level pool is ${f(EN.DL.d0)} ${ci(EN.DL.lo, EN.DL.hi)} with I² = ${EN.DL.I2.toFixed(2)}, so the size of the effect varies a great deal by domain.`;
  } else {
    const us = EN.units.filter(x => x.auc_R2 != null);
    rows = us.map(x => ({kind:'pair', label:x.name, short:x.u, base:x.auc_R2, est:x.auc_R3, color:C.accent, valText:`${u(x.auc_R2)} → ${u(x.auc_R3)}`, tip:`<b>${x.name}</b><br>Within-stratum AUC<br>R2 baseline ${u(x.auc_R2)}<br>R3 retained frontier ${u(x.auc_R3)}<br>gain ${f(x.auc_R3 - x.auc_R2)}`}));
    const lo = Math.min(...us.map(x => x.auc_R2)) - 0.01, hi = Math.max(...us.map(x => x.auc_R3)) + 0.01;
    intervalChart($('en-forest'), {label:'Within-stratum AUC, baseline versus retained frontier', xTitle:'Within-stratum AUC for the entered field (axis does not start at 0)', xTitleShort:'Within-stratum AUC', domain:[lo, hi], incl0:false, rows});
    $('en-legend').innerHTML = '<li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base);border-radius:50%"></span>R2 baseline</li><li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%"></span>R3 with retained frontier</li>';
    const gains = us.map(x => x.auc_R3 - x.auc_R2);
    $('en-take').innerHTML = `Adding the retained frontier raises the within-stratum AUC by ${u(Math.min(...gains))} to ${u(Math.max(...gains))} across the four held-out groups. The coefficient is large and consistent, but the ranking of candidate fields barely moves: field size and the other baseline terms already carry most of it.`;
  }
}
radios($('en-metric'), 'enm', [['d0', 'Coefficient d<sub>0</sub>'], ['auc', 'Ranking AUC vs baseline']], enMetric, v => { enMetric = v; drawEnForest(); });

const SS = EN.strata_sample, FN = EN.fields;
function rankOf(c, idx, j){ const p = c[j][idx]; return 1 + c.filter(r => r[idx] > p).length; }
SS.forEach(s => { const ent = s.cand.map((r, j) => r[8] === 1 ? j : -1).filter(j => j >= 0); s.ent = ent; s.r2 = ent.map(j => rankOf(s.cand, 9, j)); s.r3 = ent.map(j => rankOf(s.cand, 10, j));
  const d = s.r2.reduce((a, v, k) => a + (v - s.r3[k]), 0); s.cmp = d > 0 ? 'better' : d < 0 ? 'worse' : 'same'; });
const stS = {unit:'SOC', filter:'all', idx:null};
function stList(){ return SS.map((s, k) => ({s, k})).filter(o => o.s.u === stS.unit && (stS.filter === 'all' || o.s.cmp === stS.filter)).sort((a, b) => a.s.name.localeCompare(b.s.name) || a.s.y - b.s.y); }
function fillStPick(){ const L = stList(), sel = $('st-pick'); sel.innerHTML = ''; L.forEach(o => sel.appendChild(E('option', {value:o.k}, `${esc(o.s.name)}, ${o.s.y}`)));
  if(!L.some(o => o.k === stS.idx)) stS.idx = L.length ? L[0].k : null; if(stS.idx != null) sel.value = stS.idx;
  const all = SS.filter(s => s.u === stS.unit), nb = all.filter(s => s.cmp === 'better').length, nw = all.filter(s => s.cmp === 'worse').length;
  $('st-count').textContent = `${L.length} strata listed. Of the ${all.length} embedded ${stS.unit} strata, R3 ranks the entered field higher than the baseline in ${nb}, lower in ${nw}, and the same in ${all.length - nb - nw}.`; }
function drawStratum(){
  if(stS.idx == null){ $('st-chart').innerHTML = ''; $('st-detail').innerHTML = '<p class="note">No stratum matches this filter.</p>'; $('st-take').textContent = ''; return; }
  const s = SS[stS.idx], c = s.cand.map((r, j) => ({r, j})).sort((a, b) => b.r[10] - a.r[10]);
  const entNames = s.ent.map(j => FN[s.cand[j][0]]);
  $('st-detail').innerHTML = `<dl class="kv" style="max-width:520px"><dt>Concept, year</dt><dd>${esc(s.name)}, ${s.y}</dd><dt>Off-home fields retaining it</dt><dd>${s.n_ret}</dd><dt>Candidate fields</dt><dd>${s.cand.length}</dd><dt>Entered</dt><dd>${entNames.map(esc).join(', ')}</dd></dl>`;
  barChart($('st-chart'), {label:'Candidate fields for ' + s.name + ' in ' + s.y, series:[{name:'R2', color:C.base}, {name:'R3', color:C.accent}], xTitle:'Within-stratum probability of being the field entered', xTitleShort:'Probability of entry',
    rows:c.map(({r, j}) => { const e = r[8] === 1, nm = FN[r[0]] || ('Field ' + r[0]);
      return {label:(e ? '● ' : '') + nm, bold:e, hl:e, vals:[r[9], r[10]], colors:[C.base, e ? C.warn : C.accent],
        tip:`<b>${esc(nm)}</b>${e ? ' (entered)' : ''}<br>R2 baseline ${u(r[9], 4)} (rank ${rankOf(s.cand, 9, j)})<br>R3 retained frontier ${u(r[10], 4)} (rank ${rankOf(s.cand, 10, j)})<br>relatedness to retaining fields (raw) ${u(r[7], 3)}<br>log field size ${u(r[2], 2)}`,
        aria:`${nm}${e ? ', entered' : ''}: baseline ${u(r[9], 3)}, retained frontier ${u(r[10], 3)}`}; })});
  const parts = s.ent.map((j, k) => `${esc(FN[s.cand[j][0]])} ranks ${s.r2[k]} of ${s.cand.length} under the baseline and ${s.r3[k]} under the retained-frontier model`);
  $('st-take').innerHTML = `${esc(s.name)}, ${s.y}: ${parts.join('; ')}. ` + (s.cmp === 'better' ? 'Here relatedness to the retaining fields pulls the right field up.' : s.cmp === 'worse' ? 'Here the retained-frontier term pushes the right field down: a failure case.' : 'Here the extra term does not change its rank.');
}
function drawAgg(){
  const A = EN.agg_full, names = {PHYS:'Physical Sciences', LIFEENV:'Life & Environment', SOC:'Social Sciences', MATHDEC:'Math & Decision'};
  const rows = Object.keys(names).map(k => [names[k], A[k]]);
  $('st-agg').innerHTML = `<caption class="sr">Entry ranks over all held-out strata</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Group</th><th scope="col" class="num">Strata</th><th scope="col" class="num">Entry events</th><th scope="col" class="num">Top-1, R2</th><th scope="col" class="num">Top-1, R3</th><th scope="col" class="num">R3 ranks higher</th><th scope="col" class="num">R3 ranks lower</th></tr></thead><tbody>` +
    rows.map(([n, a]) => `<tr><th scope="row">${n}</th><td class="num">${a.strata.toLocaleString()}</td><td class="num">${a.events.toLocaleString()}</td><td class="num">${pct(a.top1_R2 / a.events)}</td><td class="num">${pct(a.top1_R3 / a.events)}</td><td class="num">${a.better.toLocaleString()}</td><td class="num">${a.worse.toLocaleString()}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody>';
  $('st-agg-cap').textContent = 'Computed by the build script over every held-out stratum in the file (not only the embedded sample), from the recorded R2 and R3 predictions. ' + EN.sample_rule + '.';
}
(function(){ const s = $('st-unit'); ['PHYS', 'LIFEENV', 'SOC', 'MATHDEC'].forEach(k => s.appendChild(E('option', {value:k}, k))); s.value = stS.unit; })();
$('st-unit').addEventListener('change', e => { stS.unit = e.target.value; fillStPick(); drawStratum(); });
$('st-pick').addEventListener('change', e => { stS.idx = +e.target.value; drawStratum(); });
radios($('st-filter'), 'stf', [['all', 'All'], ['better', 'R3 ranks it higher'], ['worse', 'R3 ranks it lower']], 'all', v => { stS.filter = v; fillStPick(); drawStratum(); });

/* =========================== 6. TRY IT =========================== */
const M = EN.model, dIdx = M.covs.indexOf('d0_ret_rel');
SS.forEach(s => s.cand.forEach(r => { let base = 0; M.covs.forEach((k, i) => { const z = (r[1 + i] - M.std[k].mean) / M.std[k].sd; if(k === 'd0_ret_rel') r.dz = M.R3[k] * z; else base += M.R3[k] * z; }); r.base = base; }));
function scoreStrata(list, mult){
  let ev = 0, top = 0, rsum = 0, maxd = 0;
  list.forEach(s => { const sc = s.cand.map(r => r.base + mult * r.dz), mx = Math.max(...sc), w = sc.map(v => Math.exp(v - mx)), t = w.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0), p = w.map(v => v / t);
    if(mult === 1) s.cand.forEach((r, j) => { maxd = Math.max(maxd, Math.abs(p[j] - r[10])); });
    s.ent.forEach(j => { const rk = 1 + p.filter(v => v > p[j]).length; ev++; rsum += rk; if(rk === 1) top++; }); });
  return {ev, top:top / ev, rank:rsum / ev, maxd};
}
function baseStats(list){ let ev = 0, top = 0, rsum = 0; list.forEach(s => s.r2.forEach(rk => { ev++; rsum += rk; if(rk === 1) top++; })); return {ev, top:top / ev, rank:rsum / ev}; }
let tryUnit = 'all', curve = [];
function tryList(){ return SS.filter(s => tryUnit === 'all' || s.u === tryUnit); }
function buildCurve(){ const L = tryList(); curve = []; for(let k = 0; k <= 60; k++){ const m = k * 0.05; curve.push([m, scoreStrata(L, m).top]); } }
function drawTry(){
  const k = +$('try-k').value, L = tryList(), res = scoreStrata(L, k), b = baseStats(L), one = scoreStrata(L, 1);
  $('try-kval').textContent = `${k.toFixed(2)}× fitted = coefficient ${u(k * M.R3.d0_ret_rel, 3)}`;
  $('try-b').textContent = pct(b.top); $('try-m').textContent = pct(res.top); $('try-m2').textContent = `${res.ev} entry events in ${L.length} strata`;
  $('try-r').textContent = u(res.rank, 2); $('try-r2').textContent = `baseline R2: ${u(b.rank, 2)}`;
  const ys = curve.map(p => p[1]).concat([b.top]), lo = Math.max(0, Math.min(...ys) - 0.03), hi = Math.min(1, Math.max(...ys) + 0.03);
  lineChart($('try-chart'), {label:'Top-1 hit rate against d0 weight', xdom:[0, 3], ydom:[lo, hi], xTitle:'Weight on retained-frontier relatedness (× fitted DEV coefficient)', yTitle:'Entered field ranked first', xSuffix:'×',
    series:[{pts:curve.map(p => [p[0], p[1]]), color:C.accent}], hlines:[{y:b.top}], vlines:[1],
    points:[{x:k, y:res.top, tip:`<b>${k.toFixed(2)}× fitted</b><br>top-1 ${pct(res.top)}<br>mean rank ${u(res.rank, 2)}<br>R2 baseline top-1 ${pct(b.top)}`, aria:`At ${k.toFixed(2)} times the fitted weight, top-1 hit rate ${pct(res.top)}`}]});
  $('try-check').textContent = `Check: at 1.00× the page reproduces the recorded R3 probabilities for all ${L.reduce((a, s) => a + s.cand.length, 0).toLocaleString()} candidate rows to within ${one.maxd.toFixed(4)} (the recorded values carry four significant digits). The dotted vertical line marks the fitted weight.`;
  const at1 = one.top, at0 = scoreStrata(L, 0).top;
  $('try-take').innerHTML = `At ${k.toFixed(2)}×, the entered field is the model’s first choice in ${pct(res.top)} of ${res.ev} entry events, against ${pct(b.top)} for the recorded R2 baseline. Removing the term (0×) gives ${pct(at0)} and the fitted weight gives ${pct(at1)}: the retained frontier nudges the ranking, while field size and density do most of the work.`;
}
(function(){ const s = $('try-unit'); [['all', 'All embedded held-out strata'], ['PHYS', 'PHYS'], ['LIFEENV', 'LIFEENV'], ['SOC', 'SOC'], ['MATHDEC', 'MATHDEC']].forEach(([v, l]) => s.appendChild(E('option', {value:v}, l))); })();
$('try-k').addEventListener('input', drawTry);
$('try-unit').addEventListener('change', e => { tryUnit = e.target.value; buildCurve(); drawTry(); });

/* =========================== 7. FAILURES =========================== */
let rbFail = false;
const SHORT = {primary:'Primary R3', strict:'S_strict', crossed:'Crossed bootstrap', fieldFE:'Field FE', rca:'RCA entry', dose2:'Dose 2 yr', dose3:'Dose 3 yr', dose4:'Dose 4+ yr', volmatch:'Volume-matched', mincp:'Min-cp proximity'};
function drawRb(){
  const L = EN.specs.filter(s => !rbFail || s.fail);
  intervalChart($('rb-chart'), {label:'d0 under alternative specifications', xTitle:'Estimate (log-odds per SD; contrast for the volume-matched row)', xTitleShort:'Estimate', refs:[{x:0}],
    rows:L.map(s => ({label:s.label, short:SHORT[s.k], est:s.est, lo:s.lo, hi:s.hi, color:s.fail ? C.warn : C.accent, valText:f(s.est) + (s.lo != null ? ' ' + ci(s.lo, s.hi) : ''),

onChange(v); }); host.appendChild(lab); });\n}\n\n/* ---------- glossary + term tooltips ---------- */\nconst GLOSS = {\n  ego:['Co-occurrence ego network','The concept’s positive-PMI neighbour topics in the topic co-occurrence backbone over its first three years (t0 to t0+2); edges are links between those topics in the backbone.'],\n  b5:['B5 baseline','The five-feature popularity baseline: log early volume, publication growth, non-home share, Shannon entropy and field reach, all computed over t0 to t0+2.'],\n  open:['OPEN index','The mean of six signed z-scored ego-network components from t0 to t0+2: new edge rate, number of Leiden communities, participation coefficient and NOV_res (positive sign), ego density and edge persistence (negative sign). OPEN_all uses the corpus-wide graph; OPEN_sizematch subsamples corpus-wide papers to home counts.'],\n  psp:['Partial Spearman priority (PSP)','The Pearson correlation of rank-transformed indicator and outcome residuals, both residualised on the baseline covariates and control rungs. `<br>Placebo 95th pct |PSP| (R2): ${u(r.placebo_p95)}` : '') + `<br>Status: ${esc(r.status)}`}; };\n  pool.bodies.forEach(bk => { if(byBody[bk]) out.push(mk(byBody[bk], false)); });\n  out.push({kind:'diamond', label:`DL pool (k = ${pool.k})`, short:'Pool', est:pool.est, lo:pool.lo, hi:pool.hi, color:C.ink, bold:true, valText:f(pool.est) + ' ' + ci(pool.lo, pool.hi),\n    tip:`<b>DerSimonian–Laird pool</b> over ${pool.k} non-selection bodies<br>${f(pool.est)} ${ci(pool.lo, pool.hi)}, I² = ${i2(pool.I2)}<br>${pool.sign} positive`});\n  const selRows = rows.filter(r => !pool.bodies.includes(r.body));\n  if(ev.sel && selRows.length){ out.push({kind:'sep'}); selRows.forEach(r => { const m = mk(r, true); if(r.body === 'B4_COHORT_2015_17'){ m.label = '2015–17 cohort (selection)'; m.short = 'Coh. 15–17 (sel.)'; } out.push(m); }); }\n  intervalChart($('ev-chart'), {rows:out, xTitle:`Partial Spearman of ${FEATT[ev.feature]} with O2r (m = 50)`, xTitleShort:'Partial Spearman with O2r', refs:[{x:0, dash:'5 4'}, {x:pool.est, dash:'1.5 3', color:C.ink}], label:'Forest plot of partial Spearman by body'});\n  const non = pool.bodies.map(b => byBody[b]).filter(Boolean).map(r => r[ev.rung]);\n  const npos = non.filter(c => c.psp > 0).length, nci = non.filter(c => c.lo > 0).length;\n  const selTxt = ev.feature === 'OPEN_home' ? `The DEV selection body (${f(pool.sel)}) is ${pool.shrink.toFixed(2)}× the pool, the shrinkage expected after choosing an index on the same data.` : `The selection bodies (DEV and the 2015–17 cohort, where the index was chosen) are left out of the pool.`;\n  $('ev-take').innerHTML = `${FEAT[ev.feature]} at rung ${ev.rung}: positive in ${npos} of ${non.length} non-selection bodies, but only ${nci} of them have a 95% CI above zero on their own. The run's recorded concept-bootstrap intervals are [0.074, 0.219], [0.347, 0.458] and [0.245, 0.345]. The page shows the recorded values, as the paper's entry-model figure does, and a note under that chart states the mismatch. You may want to fix the table in `paper.tex`.

A related case: the paper says Life & Environment is the weakest openness body at +0.042. The recorded Life & Environment value is +0.067, and the value closest to +0.042 is Social Sciences at +0.044. The page doesn't repeat that sentence and shows only the recorded per-body values.

Apart from those, I checked 31 of the paper's numbers against the finished page and all are digit-for-digit correct (the one I checked in the default view is shown once the chart is switched to OPEN_home). They include the headline +0.069 [+0.038, +0.100], all of Table 2, d₀ = 0.322 [0.291, 0.355] with LR 325.8, the pooled 0.243 with I² = 0.92, and the failing checks.

**What the page contains:**
- **The finding:** a forest plot of the openness index across the six held-out bodies, with the pooled estimate, a shuffled-outcome placebo band and the grey development set. You can switch the signal, the control level (R0/R2/R3) and whether the development set shows.
- **How it works:** a six-stage stepper that follows the GPU concept through the method. At the scoring stage it recomputes the openness index live from the recorded components, and the result matches the recorded value exactly. The last stage compares GPU with its matched partner, the vertical-axis wind turbine.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - The indicator screen, with the pooled result for each of the ten frozen indicators and a per-group breakdown.
  - A browser over all 1,443 concepts of the 2015–17 cohort, putting the baseline forecast, the forecast with openness added and the observed breadth side by side, plus a scatter chart.
  - The next-field model: a per-group chart, and a browser that shows every field a concept could have entered in a given year, with both models' probabilities and the field it actually entered.
- **Try it:** a slider scales the retained-frontier term and re-scores the embedded cases exactly. At 1.00× it reproduces the recorded predictions to within 0.0012.
- **Where it fails:** a toggle that isolates the checks that break the retained-frontier claim, a chart comparing the churn measure before and after noise controls, a list of open concepts that stayed narrow, and the paper's limitations.
